author: reek
body: General-relativistic black hole renderer. Ray-marches photons through curved spacetime around a Schwarzschild black hole. Volumetric accretion disk with FBM plasma noise, relativistic Doppler beaming, corona glow, orbiting sun, gas giant, and background starfield. All geometry in Real approximate (f32). Color accumulated as f32 triplets, gamma-corrected to Rgb at output.
